scripts.build:pre-commit: npm run build:ui:version && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:pre-commit && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.build:ui: npm run build:pre-commit && flutter build web
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:functions && flutter build web
scripts.test:ui:unit: flutter test test/ --coverage --coverage-path=coverage/all.info && lcov --extract coverage/all.info 'lib/models/*' 'lib/services/*' -o coverage/lcov.info && lcov --summary coverage/lcov.info
scripts.test:ci: npm run test --prefix functions && npm run test:ui:unit
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && lcov --summary coverage/lcov.info && genhtml coverage/lcov.info -o coverage/html
scripts.dev:emulate: npm run build:functions && cross-env METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none npm run test:emulate
scripts.dev: npm run dev:emulate -- "npm run test:data && npm run dev:ui -- web-server"
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run dev:emulate -- "npm run test:data && npm run dev:ui -- chrome"
scripts.dev:edge: npm run dev:emulate -- "npm run test:data && npm run dev:ui -- edge"
